t: You're at the London base of YouGov, an international internet-based market research and data analytics firm, headquartered in the UK. It has operations in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. It was founded by two people. Stephan Shakespeare is a German-born co-founder who is now its chief executive. Nadhim Zahawi, the other founder, went on to become a politician. He served as a minister under four prime ministers between 2018 and 2023, and was Member of Parliament for Stratford-on-Avon from 2010 to 2024.
